Name: Lantern Knight
Mechanics: A keyblade-bearing pioneer. Travel to charge a lantern pulse; build a bustling brigade.

Name: Postmaster
Mechanics: A wandering parcel launcher. Collected gold charges automatic express volleys.

Name: Drowsy Seer
Mechanics: A sleepy tuning-bell oracle. Stand still to chill nearby threats and erase a few hostile bullets.

Name: The Root Oracle
Mechanics: Stationary in combat. Whole-arena pickup and a slowing ward. Walks in shops.

Name: The Lone Jelly
Mechanics: No companions. Growing attacks and an automatic whirl. Shops sell relics only.

Name: Lady Loaded Dice
Themes: hearth, archive, clock, frost, orchard, astral, tidal, oddity
Mechanics: Collect 6 gold to burst nearby enemies. High luck and critical chance; low health.

Name: The Tide Singer
Mechanics: Collect 8 gold to heal 3 health and push nearby enemies back.

Name: The Comet Courier
Mechanics: Travel 10 units to release a slowing pulse. Moving charges it; shops do not.

Name: The Mirror Keeper
Mechanics: Stand still for 2 seconds to reflect up to 3 nearby bullets. Moving resets charge.

Name: The Treasure Clerk
Mechanics: Every 10 collected gold grants 1 extra gold and a small healing pulse.

Name: Verdant Matron
Mechanics: Nursery shops sell Little Sprouts. Buying a Sprout adds 1 projectile (max 6) and costs 2 maximum HP. Three Sprouts grow into a random evolved friend plus a Grand Sprout.

Name: Copper Cauldron
Mechanics: Start with +8 contact damage. Each Morning Bells activation gives +0.15 armor. Taking damage adds 0.15 regeneration for this run. Enemies move 10% faster.

Name: China Marionette
Mechanics: Healing is 2.5 times as effective, but armor starts 0.25 lower. Each Wild Stitch activation adds 0.4 regeneration. Taking damage adds 1 contact damage.

Name: Soap Skater
Mechanics: Ordinary attacks deal 35% less damage. Push ordinary enemies harder, within the push cap. Each Clockwork Union activation adds 4 wave income. Treasure +20%.

Name: Velvet Regent
Mechanics: You do not attack. Your personal damage, attack speed, critical chance and projectile bonuses also help allies. Shops may sell evolved companions. More enemies appear.

Name: Button Cavalier
Mechanics: Start with 35% dodge and 35% less HP. Dodge cap: 75%. Dodges add treasure detection for this run. Toy Knights deal 30% more damage.

Name: Night Maw
Mechanics: Lose 1 HP each second in battle. Each enemy defeated heals 1 HP. Regeneration and hearts do not heal. Every fourth wave raises everyone's movement speed.

Name: Thorn Treasurer
Mechanics: Dream shops always open. At wave start, maximum HP follows saved gold (20–400). Buying a spiked relic recruits a Bristle Ball. Team damage -20%.

Name: Citrus Marshal
Mechanics: You do not attack. Move 20% faster and gain 50% HP. Allies stay close; contact damage scales with your movement speed. Team attack speed -25%.

Name: Ivory Sovereign
Mechanics: Start each wave with 12 royal health. Each injury consumes exactly 1 royal health and releases a short retaliation. Ordinary healing cannot refill it. Velvet Court allies gain a projectile.

Name: Petal Citadel
Mechanics: Start each wave with a balanced blessing: +2 flat melee and ranged damage, +10 HP, +5% speed and +0.15 armor.

Name: Patchwork Host
Mechanics: All ordinary companion themes may appear. Enemy health +35%, enemy count +20%. Rerolls cost 1 less gold.

Name: Archive Curator
Mechanics: Shops offer memory companions. Buying one absorbs its support trait instead of adding a body. Each memory makes enemies 4% tougher. Your positive personal modifiers are 25% stronger.

Name: Penny Broker
Mechanics: Relics cost 20% less. Rerolls cost 2 more gold. Each paid refresh adds 1 income and 1% luck for this run.

Name: Storm Fencer
Mechanics: You do not attack normally. Your contact damage is doubled. Dodging triggers a short forward lightning barrage. Start with +20% dodge.

Name: Tin Virtuoso
Mechanics: Your shots cannot split. Allies fire only in response to your critical attacks, with their own weapon damage and a short cooldown. Start with +10% critical chance and 2 projectiles.

Name: Moon Prowler
Mechanics: Move 20% faster. Every 3 seconds spent moving in combat grants 2 gold. Each ally reduces wave income by 1.

Name: Supper Mortar
Mechanics: Fire up to two delayed mortar shells. Shells cannot pierce. Start with +0.4 armor and +15% movement speed. Enemies move 20% faster.

Name: Lantern Weaver
Mechanics: Every fourth attack stitches three nearby enemies with a delayed lantern thread. The thread shares one damage budget.

Name: Hourglass Stag
Mechanics: Every 6 seconds, briefly slow nearby ordinary enemies and release an expanding clock ring. Bosses keep moving.

Name: Rain Archivist
Mechanics: Each opened chest heals 4 HP and records a raindrop. Every third record releases a fan of frost shots.
